title: Calibration Protocol for OD600 Inter-equipment Conversion with LUDOX
author: Paul Rutten
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5gig3ue
materials: You have now completed this calibration protocol

steps.title: Add calibration samples
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL LUDOX CL‑X to wells A1, B1, C1, and D1, then add 100 µL ddH₂O to wells A2, B2, C2, and D2 of the same plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL LUDOX CL‑X to wells A1–D1.
Add 100 µL ddH₂O to wells A2–D2.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance at 600 nm of all wells using the plate‑reader measurement mode you plan to use for cell density readings.

steps.title: Record absorbance data
steps.instruction: Record the raw absorbance values for each well in your notebook or in a table.

steps.title: Open calibration spreadsheet
steps.instruction: Open the provided file “iGEM 2019 Plate Reader LUDOX Calibration.xlsx” to process the data.

steps.title: Enter raw data
steps.instruction: Input the raw absorbance values from step 3 into the blue cells of the spreadsheet.

steps.title: Calculate correction factor
steps.instruction: The spreadsheet will automatically calculate corrected Abs600 (raw Abs600 minus the H₂O reading) and the reference OD600 (provided in the sheet). The correction factor is computed as Reference OD600 ÷ Corrected Abs600; future OD600 values are obtained by multiplying measured Abs600 by this factor (example factor = 1.585).
